page_title: BHA 2-2 WOL | Brighton v Wolves 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Gomes comes onto the pitch so that Carlos Forbs (Wolves) can be given a rest.
90+4' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is replaced by Andre.
90+3' Goal! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Bart Verbruggen. He makes it 2:2.
90+2' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
90+1' Here is a change. Joao Gomes is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
89' Substitution. Kaoru Mitoma leaves the pitch and is replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
88' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.

86' 2 - 0 Goal! Tariq Lamptey displays great vision and sends a pass to Evan Ferguson (Brighton), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:0.

84' Poor effort! The corner picks out Craig Dawson (Wolves) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
84' Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.

84' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Wolves get a corner.
83' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
80' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Georginio Rutter will be replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
80' Substitution. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) on for Carlos Baleba.

80' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
78' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

76' Bart Verbruggen pulls off a fantastic save! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
75' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
73' Danny Welbeck goes off the pitch and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brajan Gruda replaces Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
72' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen pulls off a comfortable save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Igor (Brighton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

70' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went low in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.

68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Bart Verbruggen allowed him to make a comfortable save.

67' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

65' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
64' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
62' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
59' The corner from Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence.
58' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Brighton win a corner kick.
57' The referee shows the yellow card to Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves).
56' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Georginio Rutter (Brighton) for his blatant foul.

53' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the left side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Bart Verbruggen makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
53' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Carlos Forbs and he is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
53' The substitution has been made. Andre (Wolves) has replaced Jorgen Strand Larsen.
53' The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
52' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brajan Gruda (Brighton) replacing Ferdi Kadioglu.
51' Brighton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
50' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
46' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) replaces Mario Lemina.
46' Substitution. Carlos Forbs (Wolves) has come on for Toti.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Georginio Rutter provides Danny Welbeck (Brighton) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

43' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
42' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
41' Toti (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
39' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
38' A nice individual effort by Georginio Rutter (Brighton) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joao Gomes (Wolves).
36' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
31' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' The resulting corner from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) comes to nothing.
28' Jose Sa (Wolves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
27' Jose Sa (Wolves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Joel Veltman (Brighton) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
24' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
23' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

23' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the right post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Jose Sa and his brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
22' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
20' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
17' The free kick is taken by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton), but ball is cleared.

16' Joao Gomes (Wolves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Brighton, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' The ball is cleared after Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared by the defence.
12' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
10' Dangerous play by Toti (Wolves). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton earn a free kick.
9' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
7' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
5' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

5' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
2' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver was nominated as the referee for this game.
